# Daily Report — 2026-10-20

## Task Completed
Add transform map tools (sys_transform_map for data import).

New file `transform_map_tools.py` adds full CRUD plus a trigger action:
- `list_transform_maps` — GET sys_transform_map with name/source_table/target_table/active filters and pagination
- `get_transform_map` — GET by sys_id or exact name with 404/empty-result guards
- `create_transform_map` — POST with required name/source_table/target_table and optional active/run_business_rules/enforce_mandatory_fields/copy_empty_fields/order flags; booleans serialised as strings
- `update_transform_map` — PATCH; empty-body guard; 404 guard; sys_id/name resolver
- `delete_transform_map` — DELETE; 204/404 handling; sys_id/name resolver
- `run_transform` — POST /api/now/import/{staging_table} to insert a staging row and trigger all active maps for that table; normalises both list and dict result shapes

All six tools registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and `config/tool_packages.yaml` (system_administrator and full packages).
